body:
Thanks her rescuers, recovers her pendant and returns to the sea with her companions.

Recorded role and choices

The July–August 2025 rescue records Amaira’s concern for her companions and missing pendant, her trust in Fulmin’s help and her thanks to Oleander. She returns a borrowed cloak and receives Fulmin’s parting gift before entering the water. These actions support a distinct rescued character, without inferring a wider royal identity or a permanent relationship from courtesy and gratitude.

Prominence and evidence

Prominence unrated. The source footprint alone does not establish the importance of this identity. Consequences, institutional or witness role and relationships need a supported assessment.

Recorded presence combines dialogue volume and span. A brief appearance can still have lasting consequences; missing context is left unrated rather than assigned a low importance.

Archive record

The census records 11 posts across 2025-07-25 → 2025-08-07. These dates identify when messages were posted, not automatically when events happened. An encounter label can refer to a form, a collective or more than one scene identity.
